name: deployments
title: Deployments
description: Table with observation sites and survey events. A deployment is a site visit, fixed station, or repeat-photo point. Handheld documentary work still gets a deployment row (the visit).

fields.name: deploymentID
fields.description: Unique identifier of the deployment.

fields.name: locationID
fields.description: Stable identifier of the place. Reuse the same locationID across deployments when the same plot, stake, shoreline mark, or station is revisited.

fields.name: locationName
fields.description: Name given to the location.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Latitude of the deployment in decimal degrees (WGS84). Required unless `spatialPrivacy` is `withheld`.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Longitude of the deployment in decimal degrees (WGS84). Required unless `spatialPrivacy` is `withheld`.

fields.name: coordinateUncertainty
fields.description: Horizontal distance in meters from the given coordinates describing the smallest circle containing the true location. Use when coordinates are rounded or generalized.

fields.name: elevation
fields.description: Elevation of the deployment above mean sea level.

fields.name: spatialPrivacy
fields.description: How coordinates in this row may be published. `exact` publishes the recorded location. `generalized` means coordinates were coarsened (`coordinateUncertainty` should be set). `withheld` means coordinates are omitted from the public package.

fields.name: embargoUntil
fields.description: Date after which the deployment location and associated media may be made public. Formatted as ISO 8601 date (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Empty means no embargo.

fields.name: deploymentStart
fields.description: Date and time at which the deployment or site visit started. ISO 8601 with timezone designator.

fields.name: deploymentEnd
fields.description: Date and time at which the deployment or site visit ended. For a single handheld visit, this may equal `deploymentStart` plus the session length. ISO 8601 with timezone designator.

fields.name: setupBy
fields.description: Name or identifier of the person or organization that established the deployment.

fields.name: fixedPoint
fields.description: `true` if this deployment is a permanently marked repeat-photo or monitoring point intended for temporal alignment.

fields.name: cameraModel
fields.description: Manufacturer and model of the camera or recording device. Formatted as `manufacturer-model`.

fields.name: lens
fields.description: Lens or optic used for the deployment, when relevant to repeat photography or photometry.

fields.name: focalLength
fields.description: Focal length used at the deployment. Especially relevant for fixed-point repeats.

fields.name: cameraHeading
fields.description: Horizontal aiming angle, decimal degrees clockwise from north (`0` north, `90` east, `180` south, `270` west).

fields.name: cameraTilt
fields.description: Vertical aiming angle in degrees (`-90` down, `0` horizontal, `90` up).

fields.name: cameraRoll
fields.description: Rotation about the lens axis in degrees.

fields.name: fieldOfView
fields.description: Horizontal field of view of the deployed optic.

fields.name: cameraHeight
fields.description: Height of the camera above the surface. Not to be combined with `cameraDepth`.

fields.name: cameraDepth
fields.description: Depth of the camera below the water surface. Not to be combined with `cameraHeight`.

fields.name: featureType
fields.description: Landscape or infrastructure feature associated with the deployment, if any.

fields.name: habitat
fields.description: Short characterization of the habitat or setting at the deployment location.

fields.name: deploymentGroups
fields.description: Spatial, temporal, or project groupings. Pipe-separated, preferably `key:value` pairs.

fields.name: deploymentTags
fields.description: Tags associated with the deployment. Pipe-separated, optionally `key:value` pairs.

fields.name: deploymentComments
fields.description: Comments or notes about the deployment.
